name: tree-sitter-curios
description: Curios grammars for tree-sitter: programs, and Core text

scripts.generate: tree-sitter generate && cd core && tree-sitter generate
scripts.test: npm run generate && git status --short src core/src && test -z "$(git status --porcelain src core/src)" && tree-sitter test && (cd core && tree-sitter test) && npm run test:corpus && npm run test:highlights
scripts.test:corpus: find ../../curios-prelude/std ../../programs -name '*.crs' -exec tree-sitter parse -q {} + && find ../../xboard/tickets -name '*.crsc' -exec tree-sitter parse -q -p core {} +
scripts.test:highlights: find ../../curios-prelude/std ../../programs -name '*.crs' -exec tree-sitter query -q ../zed/languages/curios/highlights.scm {} + && find ../../xboard/tickets -name '*.crsc' -exec tree-sitter query -q -p core ../zed/languages/curios_core/highlights.scm {} +
